failingProof: A failing proof shows the performance workstream still lacks a durable published Tier 3 readiness plan that states how Signature365-scale measurements will be captured, compared, and reviewed before broad migration starts.
A failing proof shows the current plan has benchmark, telemetry, and stress evidence, but not yet an explicit future measurement target for the next scale tier.
